proof_scope: Tau developer documentation current-vs-planned status classification

claims.proves: Primary developer docs classify aspirational planned/future/not-yet language, unmarked claims fail the drift check, marked roadmap/history/security limitations pass, and installed-wheel command surfaces named by onboarding docs are readable without source import.
claims.does_not_prove: Runtime semantic correctness, provider/model quality, full GOAL.md completion, security certification, or human acceptance.

capability_claims.description: Developer-facing docs distinguish current contracts from known limitations, roadmap/history, and security non-claims.

cases.name: developer-doc-status-live-readback
command: cd .. && rm -rf local/agentic-evals/tau-doc-status && uv run python scripts/agentic-eval-tau-doc-status.py --work local/agentic-evals/tau-doc-status/work --out local/agentic-evals/tau-doc-status/proof.json
